findings.description: Default root.gap used a fixed space.inline-gap, so all three declared density geometries were unchanged. The old images do not satisfy density acceptance.
findings.currentStatus: L3 now points to existing L2 density.gap, token/default tests pass, actual corrected browser geometry and fresh visual review pending.

observations.description: Light dashed compatibility boundary is weak but visible; current neutral200 role is shared with shallow outline. Parent confirmed the image; design review pending. No product/upstream defect conclusion.
MD3 xl defaults wrap to two lines with complete text and boundaries. At 200%, the long button needs the second real scroll frame; the first frame alone omits its bottom.
